title: Jamile, Miki Yamanaka & Steve Wilson - Prayer To The Invisible Forces Of The Forest (O Sacrum Convivium!)

lines.l: Feed my cells with pristine air
Water down my aches and doubts
Let the leaves take all the sorrow
And replace the garments we face
I surrender to the vastness of the sea
I surrender to the paredes and the trees
I, I, I surrender to the innocence of the birds
I surrender to the pains of birth
